verdict.rationale: Logseq is a note-taking knowledge base, so a built-in AI assistant grounded in the user's notes is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no first-party AI assistant, no Q&A, summarization or drafting over notes, and no AI data-access controls. Third-party marketplace plugins and the local HTTP API are only developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant can answer questions, summarize, and draft grounded in my own notes — with clear controls over what data it sees
